class.name: NNBooleanSensor
class.brief_description: Converts a boolean flag into a [code]0.0[/code] or [code]1.0[/code] sensor value.
class.description: Exposes a simple [bool] input ([member boolean_value]) as [code]0.0[/code] ([code]false[/code]) or [code]1.0[/code] ([code]true[/code]) for considerations to read. Pairs naturally with [NNBooleanConsideration].

members.member: Boolean input mapped to [code]1.0[/code] when [code]true[/code] and [code]0.0[/code] when [code]false[/code].
